observations.observation: Pointer os.replace moves one file but leaves payload/ empty; cleanup only removes completely empty stage or ownership-only stage. Normal successful knowledge import/build may leave nonempty staging that causes backup refusal. Reproduce on frozen source.

os.walk dirnames silently removes symlink directories and inventories only files; exact-reuse can ignore symlink/empty extra directory entries. Frozen contract requires unsafe/unknown complete-set refusal.

Stored record manifest file hashes/schema/record-id/document citation shape are not checked before returning current and consuming concepts. A canonical edited document may be treated as current despite manifest mismatch.
Related-paper link inside papers/<id>.md uses papers/<other>.md rather than sibling <other>.md, likely resolves to papers/papers/<other>.md.
Existing knowledge/CURRENT.json only checked regular file, not schema/identity, before os.replace. Unknown user bytes risk overwrite. Source/heads also lack final revalidation before pointer switch.

Wrapper required fields accessed with [] after partial validation; missing coverage/paper_snapshot/prompt can raise KeyError instead of expected closed result. Reproduce complete exported wrapper with one key removed.

Cleanup trusts limited ownership marker fields and allowed filenames, without validating intended destination/full marker/payload-byte ownership. Edited partial recognized filenames could be deleted. Need test with owned interrupted stage edited before retry.
Uses legacy _load_paper without new hardlink checks on source.md/source.json; new path policy must reject hardlinked inputs.
